title: This is Why Heat Pumps May NOT Be The Future
summary: UK builder's rant that government heat pump grants are a costly mistake: heat pumps cost more to run than gas boilers, need costly retrofit work and disappoint in poorly insulated UK housing.

assertions.quote: running a heat pump is roughly three times more expensive than running a gas boiler.

verdicts.note: It depends on the price ratio and efficiency: on UK standard tariffs bills often rise, while US modelling finds most homes save with efficient units and gas-heated homes save least.
With minimum-efficiency equipment most gas homes with AC see higher bills (only 38% positive), but with cold-climate high-efficiency units 99% see lower bills.
RMI finds that switching from gas raises energy costs in cold Chicago and Providence but lowers them (though not enough to repay capital) in Houston and Oakland, so it holds only in colder climates.

LBNL: among 273 electrification projects, some raised annual energy costs (by up to $1,000) where electricity was expensive, while many cut costs substantially, mostly where oil or propane was replaced; so higher bills happen in some cases, not as a rule.

Billing was not analysed, but several participants who had gas cited higher utility bills and one would not recommend a cold-climate heat pump to neighbours with gas; respondents were manufacturer employees or affiliates, and others reported lower bills.

UK households switching from gas boilers see running costs about £190/yr higher on a standard tariff (about £83 after dropping the gas standing charge), so bills do rise modestly; but the same paper finds a heat pump time-of-use tariff saves about £318/yr, enough to reverse the rise.

The report says energy bills tend to be lower in homes with heat pumps, based on its Canadian modelling where heat pumps are the lowest lifetime-cost option in most cities; it is a model, and Edmonton is an exception.

assertions.quote: They don't work well enough in our housing stock.

verdicts.note: The UK Electrification of Heat trial installed heat pumps in every housing type, including old, poorly insulated homes, with similar efficiency; insulation lowers cost but is not a prerequisite.

assertions.quote: They put in the pipe work, buffer tank, larger radiators, or the underlo heating

verdicts.note: Heat pumps are efficient at low flow temperatures, so radiators sized for hot boiler water often need enlarging.

assertions.quote: But now you've got to spend, I would say, £16,000 doing the extra work to make the heat pump work.

verdicts.note: Installed heat pump costs typically exceed a gas furnace or boiler replacement by several thousand dollars or pounds.

assertions.quote: a lot of people are very disappointed after a couple of years of running and seeing their high electricity bills

verdicts.note: Surveys of UK and US heat pump owners find satisfaction similar to or higher than gas boiler owners.
Modelled bills rise in 39% of homes with minimum-efficiency units but only 5% with high-efficiency cold-climate units; comfort and indoor temperature are not assessed.

Some participants complained of higher bills, but about 75% kept or raised their satisfaction, average heating satisfaction rose from 3.61 to 3.88, and comfort and temperature-control problems were rare; this is a small, affiliated sample.

assertions.quote: that's the only way you're going to get that grant is if you actually junk your gas boiler out.

verdicts.note: BUS rules require the heat pump to replace the fossil fuel system fully; hybrid systems are not eligible.

assertions.quote: I can hear the fan going. My neighbors complaining about it.

verdicts.note: Modern units are typically around 40-60 dB at a few metres and complaints are uncommon, though poorly placed units can bother neighbours.
